summary: Sent on the old host connection once a move has taken effect: the relay relays no new request or WebSocket on it. It follows every earlier frame on the same socket, so a Crew that has it has every request that will ever arrive there.
planPosition: The frame, its negotiation as the move-done feature and the Crew's 5 second fallback are this contract's, added on 11/02 to close the race where a Crew closed the old connection with a request still on the wire.
encoding: One JSON object per WebSocket text frame, UTF-8. Unknown fields are ignored by the receiver.

lastId.notes: The stream id of the last request or ws-upgrade the relay relayed on this connection. Absent when there was none. For diagnostics only: a Crew must not depend on it.

valid.name: after requests on the old connection
no request was ever relayed on the old connection

invalid.name: lastId not an integer
invalid.expect: the Crew answers error invalid_message and keeps the fallback timeout

timing: Sent only on a connection whose ready listed move-done. Frames for streams opened before it, request-chunk, request-end, request-cancel, flow-credit, and ws-frame, ws-flow and ws-close on viewer WebSockets already open, still flow after it.
crewDoes: Keep answering everything that arrived on the old connection. Close it with 1000 once move-done has arrived and every stream opened before it has finished. Without move-done 5 seconds after the new connection's ready, close it with 1000 once the HTTP requests it has received are done.
